Skill `windows-infra-admin`.
Roles: `agent`, `user`.
Tool `plan_windows_change` (owner `agent`): via `windows_desktop`; needs `windows_admin_access`; adds `scope_documented`, `affected_objects_enumerated`, `maintenance_window_planned`.
Tool `export_prechange_state` (owner `agent`): via `windows_desktop`; needs `windows_admin_access`; requires `scope_documented`; adds `prechange_exports_completed`, `rollback_data_available`.
Tool `preview_change_with_whatif` (owner `agent`): via `windows_desktop`; needs `windows_admin_access`; requires `scope_documented` and `affected_objects_enumerated`; adds `whatif_preview_reviewed`.
Tool `enable_logging_and_transcript` (owner `agent`): via `windows_desktop`; needs `windows_admin_access`; adds `logging_enabled`.
Tool `apply_windows_infra_change` (owner `agent`): via `windows_desktop`; needs `windows_admin_access`; requires `scope_documented` and `affected_objects_enumerated` and `prechange_exports_completed` and `whatif_preview_reviewed` and `logging_enabled`; adds `infra_change_applied`.
Tool `validate_postchange_state` (owner `agent`): via `windows_desktop`; needs `windows_admin_access`; requires `infra_change_applied`; adds `postchange_validated`, `compliance_validated`.
Tool `rollback_windows_infra_change` (owner `agent`): via `windows_desktop`; needs `windows_admin_access`; requires `infra_change_applied` and `rollback_data_available`; removes `infra_change_applied`; adds `rolled_back`.
Initially true: none.
Goal: all of (`scope_documented`, `prechange_exports_completed`, `affected_objects_enumerated`, `whatif_preview_reviewed`, `logging_enabled`, `infra_change_applied`, `postchange_validated`, `compliance_validated`).
Protocol:
  - `agent` uses `plan_windows_change`.
  - `agent` uses `export_prechange_state`.
  - `agent` uses `preview_change_with_whatif`.
  - `agent` uses `enable_logging_and_transcript`.
  - `user` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `approve_change`:
      - `agent` uses `apply_windows_infra_change`.
      - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
        - branch `validation_passes`:
          - `agent` uses `validate_postchange_state`.
        - branch `validation_fails`:
          - `agent` uses `rollback_windows_infra_change`.
    - branch `decline_change`: none.
